shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'test:|npm.*test|working-directory' .github/workflows package.json; cat src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts; cat src/transport/ws/validation.ts; cat src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts; cat package.json"
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat src/transport/ws/connectionHandler.ts | head -45; cat src/types/messages.ts | tail -80; cat src/transport/ws/sender.ts | head -35; git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts'
s=open(p).read(); s += '''\\n/** Waits briefly for a socket's server-side close to finish. */\\nexport async function eventually(check: () => boolean): Promise<void> {\\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 50 && "'!check(); attempt++) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));'"\\n}\\n\\n/** Wraps only the required store operations, allowing tests to replace optional ones. */\\nexport function delegatingTo(inner: SessionStore): SessionStore {\\n  return {\\n    create: (sessionId, userId, options) => inner.create(sessionId, userId, options),\\n    get: sessionId => inner.get(sessionId),\\n    delete: sessionId => inner.delete(sessionId),\\n    count: () => inner.count(),\\n    clear: () => inner.clear(),\\n  };\\n}\\n'''; open(p,'w').write(s)
for p in ['src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts','src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts']:
 s=open(p).read().replace(\"import {answeringOrchestrator} from './wsTestSupport.js';\", \"import {answeringOrchestrator, eventually, delegatingTo} from './wsTestSupport.js';\")
 start=s.index('const eventually = async'); end=s.index('\\n};',start)+3; s=s[:start]+s[end:]
 start=s.index('const delegatingTo ='); end=s.index('\\n});',start)+4; s=s[:start]+s[end:]
 open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts'; s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace(\"        client.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'ping', timestamp: 1}));\\n\",''); s=s.replace(\"      if (frame.type === 'pong') {\\n        resolve();\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      frames.push(frame);\", \"      frames.push(frame);\\n      resolve();\"); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts'; s=open(p).read().replace('Array(9).fill(false)', '[false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false]'); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/transport/createServer.ts'; s=open(p).read().replace('createMessageHandler(options.orchestrator)', 'createMessageHandler(options.orchestrator, options.sessionStore)'); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts'; s=open(p).read().replace(\"import {log} from '../../shared/logger.js';\", \"import {log} from '../../shared/logger.js';\\nimport type {SessionStore} from '../../types/sessionStore.js';\\nimport type {ExtWebSocket} from './connectionHandler.js';\")
s=s.replace('export function createMessageHandler(orchestrator: ChatOrchestrator)', 'export function createMessageHandler(orchestrator: ChatOrchestrator, store?: SessionStore)')
s=s.replace('return wsErrorHandler(ws, async () => answerFrame(ws, validation));', '''return wsErrorHandler(ws, async () => {\\n      if (validation.valid && validation.data.type === 'list_sessions') {\\n        const userId = (ws as ExtWebSocket).userId;\\n        try {\\n          const sessions = (await store?.listFor?.(userId, {limit: validation.data.limit, before: validation.data.before})) ?? [];\\n          sendJson(ws, {type: 'session_list', sessions: sessions.map(row => ({...row, createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(), updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString()}))});\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          log.error('ws', 'session list failed', {userId, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'});\\n          sendError(ws, ErrorCodes.SERVER_ERROR, 'Failed to list sessions');\\n        }\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      answerFrame(ws, validation);\\n    });'''); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts'; s=open(p).read(); s += '''\\n/** Close the sockets before stopping their servers. */\\nexport async function stopTracked(\\n  clients: WebSocket[],\\n  servers: Array<ReturnType<typeof createServer>>\\n): Promise<void> {\\n  for (const client of clients.splice(0)) client.terminate();\\n  for (const hal of servers.splice(0)) {\\n    await eventually(() => hal.wss.clients.size === 0);\\n    await hal.stop();\\n  }\\n}\\n'''; open(p,'w').write(s)
for p in ['src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts','src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts']:
 s=open(p).read().replace('answeringOrchestrator, eventually, delegatingTo','answeringOrchestrator, eventually, delegatingTo, stopTracked')
 if 'conversationList' in p: s=s.replace('answeringOrchestrator, eventually, delegatingTo, stopTracked','answeringOrchestrator, delegatingTo, stopTracked')
 start=s.index('  for (const client of clients.splice(0)) client.terminate();'); end=s.index('\\n  }',start)+4
 s=s[:start]+'  await stopTracked(clients, servers);'+s[end:]; open(p,'w').write(s)
